project.name: ok-ww

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the English README to understand ok-ww: image-recognition automation for Wuthering Waves built on ok-script, without memory reads or game-file modification.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: main.py boots the ok-script application, loads config, and registers automation tasks for the GUI.

tour.title: Base Combat Task
tour.description: BaseCombatTask is the shared combat orchestration layer: skill CD tracking, character switching, and combat loop control used by farming and domain tasks.

tour.title: Character Framework
tour.description: BaseChar and CharFactory define how each resonator rotation is implemented and selected at runtime.

tour.title: Daily & Echo Workflows
tour.description: DailyTask and FarmEchoTask compose higher-level farming loops on top of combat and travel helpers.

tour.title: Combat Detection
tour.description: CombatCheck and YOLO/OpenVINO detectors determine combat state and UI features from screenshots.

tour.title: Tests & Validation
tour.description: The tests package exercises combat CD logic, echo flows, OCR, and task behaviors against fixture images.
